purpose: Records which BMEW widget-authoring surfaces have directly-observed wizard-flow doctrine in wizard-flows.md, and for which widget families. Consumed by build-widget-capability-index.mjs to answer the browser-authoring axis of a capability lookup. Status is per-surface, not per-family within a surface — where a surface's proof is thinner than 'the whole flow for every family', that is called out explicitly in its note field and in wizard-flows.md; do not infer full coverage from a 'live-proven' status alone.

surfaces.note: Fixed-list Data-source selection, Filters add-menu, and the persistence workaround are directly observed. Summary and Dynamic-window on this surface are proven only as far as their shared rail states; see wizard-flows.md.

Only the contextual Data-source picker mechanics and the route/current-record precondition are observed. No family's configuration flow beyond source selection has been proven on this surface. families is deliberately empty: do not treat any family as browser-covered here.

Covers appending one tab to an existing Tabbed-list widget via its local Add tab menu entry only. Does not cover creating the outer Tabbed-list wrapper itself, which falls under entity-dashboard-widget-authoring.
Cards and Charts are excluded from scope entirely (see SKILL.md). This row exists so a lookup against them returns an explicit deferred verdict instead of an absent-surface miss.
